title: Black Music Honors (8th)
description:
8th Annual Black Music Honors
Hosted by LeToya Luckett and DeRay Davis, the 8th Annual Black Music Honors celebrates Missy Elliott, SWV, Evelyn "Champagne" King, Jeffrey Osborne and The Hawkins Family for their significant contributions to African American music. Performances by Anthony Hamilton, Tweet, Robin Thicke, Queen Naija, Sevyn Streeter, Kelontae Gavin, Raheem DeVaughn and more pay tribute to the remarkable legacy of this year's honoree line-up.

title: Michael Jackson: Ungloved
description: From modest childhood beginnings to international fame, this is the journey of the forever 'King of Pop,' Michael Jackson's complicated world. Unquestioned talent transcends years of media scrutiny and speculation over of who was the real superstar wearing the symbolic glove.
